column7: Typo – Please note that in addition to the correction made above, there is also a "Placement Error" in locating this Supplemental Entry into the Main Entry Hierarchy. Since this is a "Proper Compound" formed by the pūrvapada "praviṣṭa", it must necessarily be placed prior to the Headword "praviṣṭaka [ID=137080 ]", which is not a "Proper Compound", but rather a derivative formed with the affix "ka". This is the standard procedure  followed in MW dictionary, and I hope that Andhrabharati will notice his name here, and confirm this placement correction which has been clearly stated.
Typo – Please note that the "line break" does not need to be retained online. To do so is simply "ridiculous" !
